## 6. Standing exclusions

Out of this case whatever the provocation: the Garrido estate; the Ida Buenaventura correspondence; Civil Case 6839; the Office of the President petitions; NBI and forgery material (the signature point is verify-first, never "forgery" from the stand); privileged mail; the ARTA referrals in the case-in-chief; the word "syndicate"; any adjective about a defendant or about the judge's 2020 orders; Exh. F ¶4's word "fraudulently" (it is the appointing instrument's wording and names no one). The case is won on dates and pages, in the court's own form: rule, "considering that," disposition.
